equivalence.linearLight: Premiere 26.5 blurs in linear light: its frames match AE only after decoding sRGB to linear (RMS 2-3 of 255); raw frames are off by RMS ~24, the transition shifted toward black. Sequence setting compositeLinearColor=false gives a byte-identical frame, so it does not help. The edge looks a little brighter/wider than in AE; the kernel width below matches.

The numbers of the pack do not carry over 1:1 to any Premiere blur.
